:::{#def-sequence}
#### Sequence

A **sequence** in a set $S$ is a [function](#def-function) $a : \mathbb{N} \to S$
from the [natural numbers](notation.qmd#def-natural-numbers) to $S$.
Its value $a(n)$ is written $a_n$ and called its $n$th **term**,
and the sequence is written $(a_n)$ or $a_1, a_2, a_3, \ldots$.

A **finite sequence** of length $n$ is a function from $\set{1, \ldots, n}$ to $S$,
written $\dsn{a}$.

:::
